status: EMPTY BY DECISION, NOT BY OMISSION
rights: No imagery is retained. M5Stack states no licence for its product photography, PinMap diagrams, store imagery or M5Burner cover art on any page retrieved on 2026-09-01, so its redistribution status is 'unknown' - and 'unknown' is not permission. The only known independent photography is four unboxing photos in a private individual's 2026-08-21 social post (@henry19840301). No independent teardown, PCB photograph, enclosure-open view, revision marking or component close-up existed at the snapshot date: that is a verified absence, not a failed search. No watermark was removed, no image was altered and no image-search result is presented as provenance, because no image was taken.
reason_empty: LICENCE - all vendor imagery carries no stated licence; redistribution status 'unknown'; committing it to a published repository would be redistribution.
THIRD-PARTY COPYRIGHT - the only independent photographs are an individual's social-media unboxing shots, cited as evidence in community.md rather than copied.
DERIVATIVE - frames from the two YouTube videos would inherit a rights problem and add no provenance.

DOES NOT EXIST - teardown, PCB front/back, enclosure-open, revision markings and component close-ups have never been published by anyone. The product was purchasable for approximately nine minutes on 2026-08-21 and was still out of stock at the snapshot date.

schema.note: Per-image record format for whoever fills this in. Every field is required. Where a value is not known, write the string "unknown" - do not omit the key. This extends the minimal {file,url,bytes,sha256,renamed_from} shape used by older manifests in this repository to the full field set required by the research method's visual-identification rules.

image_record.caption: string - what the image DEMONSTRATES, plus any crop, annotation, rotation or processing applied. Not a label
image_record.alt_text: string - descriptive alternative text for the embedded image
image_record.creator: string - creator or rightsholder where known, else "unknown"
image_record.source_page: string - the page the image was published on (NOT an image-search result page)
image_record.url: string - direct URL to the image file
image_record.published: string - YYYY-MM-DD publication date of the image or its page, else "unknown"
image_record.applies_to: string - device SKU and hardware revision the image depicts, e.g. "C153, schematic V0.6.2", or "unknown"
image_record.licence: string - licence expression or name, else "unknown"
image_record.licence_evidence: string - where the licence was seen: a LICENSE file, a page footer, a notice inside the document, or "none located"
image_record.redistribution: string - one of: allowed | conditional | restricted | unknown
image_record.disposition: string - one of: repository | archive | reference-only
image_record.modifications: string - crop, rotation, annotation, resize, format conversion, or "none"
image_record.renamed_from: string or null - the original upstream filename if the file was renamed
image_record.source_id: string or null - the S## row in sources.md, if one exists
image_record.shows: string - which of the visual-identification classes this satisfies: front | back | ports-and-labels | enclosure-open | teardown-stage | pcb-front | pcb-back | revision-marking | component-close-up | representative-use | other
